label: Webster Groves (St. Louis County, not the City of St. Louis)

county_election_office.name: St. Louis County Board of Elections, 725 Northwest Plaza Dr., St. Ann, MO 63074 (the county board, not the City of St. Louis board downtown). Mon to Fri 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

zip_caveats: Webster Groves is in St. Louis County. ZIP 63119 also reaches nearby cities and unincorporated areas. The county’s November 2026 election maps place the ZIP in County Council District 5, with state House districts 83, 90, 91, 96 and 99 and state Senate districts 1, 4 and 24. Senate District 1 has no race this year. Rock Hill precincts are in House District 91. School boundaries cross the ZIP: Affton, Brentwood, Kirkwood, Lindbergh, Maplewood Richmond Heights, Ladue and Webster Groves schools all overlap it. Prop W applies only in the Webster Groves School District; the city charter question applies only inside Webster Groves city limits. ZIPs do not define a single ballot. Use the county’s current Sample Ballot Lookup to confirm each item.
